name: docscan
description: Document & card scanner (auto-detect, crop, perspective correction, scan filters): C++/OpenCV compiled to WebAssembly for browsers and Node.js

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'build']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
